content: Multi-step form best practice: max ~5 fields per step for highest conversion; always allow backward navigation to edit prior steps; auto-save on every step transition so users can safely exit and resume with data intact (save-and-resume can cut abandonment up to 30%); group fields into logical steps (e.g. 'personal details', 'preferences'); progress bar should communicate meaningful progress, not just a high step count that discourages starting.
